detail.longDescription: I am using MobaXterm, and have an SSH tunnel connecting port 9997 and 3306 (MySQL). I can access MySQL fine through the command line, but when I try to access it from a Python script (using python3 myscript.py on the command line), I get the error: DatabaseError: 2003 (HY000): Can't connect to MySQL server on '127.0.0.1:9997' (111). Here is myscript.py : import mysql.connector conn = mysql.connector.connect(port=9997, user='---', password='---', database='---') csr = conn.cursor() csr.execute("SELECT * FROM mytable LIMIT 10;") for i in csr: print(i) Why does it not work? I am using a remote SSH terminal. port=3306 does not work either. I discovered that using unix_socket= instead of port and host works though. Why doesn't port=3306 work?
